scientific_integrity: Proof includes all prime-field parameter cases, explicit Weyl diagonalization and quartic power-sum obstruction; exact integer code independently checks all small-prime coefficient pairs. Mathematical review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only prime cyclic groups; no general prime-power rings or finite extension fields.
No sharp positive singular-value/conditioning formula or claim of nonlinear phase-retrieval injectivity.
Quintic/cubic small-prime affine collapses and standard Hermite/Gabor principles are acknowledged as prior knowledge.
Complete text of Lüke 1996 polynomial-phase correlation paper was not accessible; historical priority remains bounded.
title: A seven-prime resonance in quintic–cubic Gabor tomography
